bugs.error_message: Playwright E2E could discover tests without proving a cold-started Vite run
bugs.root_cause: Local Playwright config could reuse an existing server, and the performance E2E auth init script was not awaited while mock endpoints did not cover refresh/stage-transition paths.

Targeted performance API handler coverage tests initially failed 403 expectations
bugs.root_cause: Non-manager branch tests used performanceHandlerTestDBWith, whose broad users stub let currentOperatorID resolve the test user as admin and bypass verifyManagerOfParticipant/participant access checks.
bugs.fix: Changed the non-manager/forbidden branch tests to use performanceCoverageDBWith without the broad base users response, so currentOperatorID falls back to the context user and the handlers return 403 as intended.

bugs.error_message: golangci-lint reported unused repository test helpers while adding performance repository coverage tests
bugs.root_cause: New coverage tests initially did not reuse existing helper functions goalRecordMatcher and stubPerformanceRowsAffected, so package-level lint still flagged those helpers as unused.
bugs.fix: Reused goalRecordMatcher for goal-record query matching and stubPerformanceRowsAffected for a participant update exec response in the new coverage test file; golangci-lint run ./internal/repository then passed with 0 issues.

bugs.error_message: Performance service notification tests could trigger real DingTalk network calls
bugs.root_cause: Coverage tests used ordinary user and manager IDs in SendSelfEvalReminders/SendManagerEvalReminders paths, so dingtalk.IsNotifiableUserID could allow SendCorpMessageToUser/SendCorpActionCardToUser to request real DingTalk tokens or messages; the tests also had weak assertions that ignored send failures.
bugs.fix: Replaced those notification test inputs with admin/system non-notifiable recipients and asserted nil errors on the skip paths, preserving branch coverage without external network dependency.

bugs.error_message: Vitest failed with Cannot find module './Performance*' and stale interaction assertions
bugs.root_cause: Four interaction tests used CommonJS require('./Performance*').default in a Vite/Vitest ESM test environment, so TSX modules were not resolved. After switching to static imports, additional stale assertions assumed unique page titles, text nodes for editable AutoComplete values, clickable readonly buttons, and single Antd message/modal nodes, which no longer matched current UI behavior.
bugs.fix: Replaced require calls with static component imports, updated assertions to use getAllByText/getByDisplayValue/testid-based row counts, filled required self-eval form fields before testing API failure, cleaned Antd message/modal overlays in test setup, and restored npm run test to the CI workflow after verifying all 352 frontend tests passed.

bugs.error_message: GitHub Actions frontend build failed with TS2352 in src/test/setup.ts requestAnimationFrame polyfill
bugs.root_cause: The polyfill called unqualified setTimeout/clearTimeout in a Vitest/jsdom project with Node types present, so TypeScript inferred NodeJS.Timeout while DOM requestAnimationFrame must return a numeric handle.
bugs.fix: Changed the polyfill to call window.setTimeout and window.clearTimeout, returning the DOM numeric timeout id and passing performance.now() to the callback; npm run build passed.

bugs.error_message: Vitest PerformanceSelfEval interaction test timed out in submit-failure case
bugs.root_cause: The test filled multiple Ant Design TextArea/InputNumber controls with userEvent.type/clear loops, making the case exceed Vitest's 5000ms timeout on the full frontend suite.
bugs.fix: Replaced the slow typing loop with fireEvent.change for setup-only form field population while keeping userEvent.click for the actual submit interaction; npm run test passed 352/352.
